name: Adaptive Gaussian Merging and Retrieval
definition: A hierarchical structure based on primitive screen size to handle large scenes with limited GPU memory, allowing merging of small Gaussians and retrieval of finer details.
summary: Adaptive Gaussian Merging and Retrieval is a view-adaptive memory strategy for 3D Gaussian Splatting that dynamically merges sub-pixel primitives and offloads them to CPU RAM to prevent VRAM exhaustion.
